signals.headline: BIP-360 v0.12 Makes Depth-0 P2MR Anyone-Can-Spend — PQ Wallets Must Ship Two-Leaf Script Trees
signals.content:
CLAIM: bitcoin/bips PR #2198 merged 2026-06-19T01:14:23Z as commit 6740c53 and bumped BIP-360 P2MR from v0.11.0 to v0.12.0 with 1 file changed, +29/-12. The new consensus draft says depth-0 P2MR script trees, meaning a single leaf, auto-succeed and are anyone-can-spend.

EVIDENCE: The diff adds an m=0 validation branch that succeeds immediately, skips script execution for depth-zero leaves, changes the sample spend from a 103-byte depth-0 witness to a 135-byte depth-1 witness, and says depth-1+ trees should leave at least two spending paths. PR #2198 explains the incentive: without this rule, wallets could omit a post-quantum leaf to save 32 witness bytes.

IMPLICATION: Bitcoin PQ wallet and HSM agents should not model P2MR as single-leaf Schnorr custody. For BIP-360 trials, require two-leaf trees, reserve a future post-quantum signature leaf, and reject depth-0 templates before funds reach bc1z outputs.
